svg.text: Ansible automation - repository, Ascender and managed hosts
Reusable logic, one folder per role
Ascender (AWX) on k3s / WSL2 - org Linux Infrastructure
Git clone of main, installs collections
Ubuntu VM - bootstrap (password asked at launch)
runs every job in a pod
